descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94423 AC 1 + AC 7; TFA-94745 AC 4; UAT OAT-03 step 7 + ER 4 · “photo reading and transcription retry automatically; if they still fail, a clear message shows”.

Bug B27 · S2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-04/S28, EFS/S17, TC-17/S19

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S08 Engine route × session outcome → which engine writes the text and what is logged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09))
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model. (UAT TC-23; UAT 3.9; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total. (UAT 3.5)
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery. (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 6; TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital pre-round box; E-3 and E-4 also on the Nursing Home Pre-Round box and Encounter Dictate, and E-4 also on Hospital Important Points, encounter notes and 'Start bedside recording'; local aiProvider.transcription = gpt-live (read only)

When Dictate H-01 (E-1…E-3) or H-03 (E-4) while the runner makes the live connection succeed, fail once, fail twice, or drop after speech has flowed

Then E-1 connects: text exact, one prepareSession row (gpt-live-transcribe), no transcribeAudio row. E-2 first connect fails before audio: one quiet retry, then ready, text exact. E-3 both fail: a clear message within about 31 s, field unchanged, no silent switch to another engine, nothing queued offline. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Expected cells from TFA-94745 AC 3 / AC 4 and Quinn's 2026-10-05 comment (T9: one retry; a dropped session's recording transcribed once with whisper-1; error only if that fails), TFA-94423 AC 1 and AC 7, UAT 3.5 (retry, then a clear message, never waiting with nothing) and TFA-94229 R9 (no dictated fact lost). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

In Nursing Home, after a dropped dictation is recovered automatically and the words are in the box, the red 'Live dictation disconnected' error stays on screen, so the physician thinks something was lost.

Evidence: allure-results/e9cc8bbb…: 7/9 decided cells pass. In NH Pre-Round and NH Encounter, 'Live dictation disconnected. Review the last phrase…' is still on screen 8 s after recovery put the text in the box; Hospital clears it. Code: the NH Pre-Round tab passes no onError, so ClientErrorBanner is never cleared, and recover() does not clear captureError. This breaks Quinn's 2026-10-05 TFA-94745 rule (error only if recovery fails). TC-23 Q16 is related. Not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
